      Kompyuter tarmoqlari (I qism)

      B.M. Babakulov

      Fan haqidaAbout the course

      «Axborot xavfsizligi (sohalar bo‘yicha)» yo‘nalishi talabalari uchun asosiy fan. Tarmoq modellari (OSI, TCP/IP), lokal va global tarmoqlar, IP manzillash, kommutatsiya va marshrutlash, tarmoq qurilmalari va protokollari o‘rganiladi. Bu bilimlar tarmoq xavfsizligini ta’minlashning poydevori hisoblanadi.

      A core course for Information Security students: network models (OSI, TCP/IP), LANs and WANs, IP addressing, switching and routing, network devices and protocols. It is the foundation for network security.

      Axborot xavfsizligi asoslari

      B.M. Babakulov

      Fan haqidaAbout the course

      60610200 – Axborot tizimlari va texnologiyalari yo‘nalishining 3-semestrida o‘tiladigan majburiy fan. Qo‘llanmada axborot xavfsizligining asosiy tushunchalari, tahdidlar va ularning turlari, sodda shifrlash algoritmlari, RSA, Diffi-Xellman protokoli, xavfsizlik siyosati, kompyuter viruslari, steganografiya, elektron tijorat va mobil tizimlar xavfsizligi yoritilgan.

      A compulsory third-semester course in programme 60610200. The guide covers core concepts, threat types, basic ciphers, RSA, the Diffie–Hellman protocol, security policy, viruses, steganography, and e-commerce and mobile security.

Telekommunikatsiya asoslari, kompyuter tarmoqlarining tarixi, lokal, korporativ va global tarmoqlar tuzilishi, ularning tezligi, texnik va dasturiy vositalari, Internetga ulanish usullari va internet protokollari yoritilgan.

      An elective in semesters 4 and 6 for programmes 60610200 and 60610300. Covers telecom basics, the history of networks, LAN, corporate and global network structures, their speeds, hardware and software, ways to connect to the Internet and Internet protocols.

      Java dasturlash tili

      E.M. Mustafoyev, R.R. Mixliyev, B.M. Babakulov

      Fan haqidaAbout the course

      «Axborot tizimlari va texnologiyalari» yo‘nalishi talabalari uchun. Java tilining sintaksisi va ma’lumot turlari, obyektga yo‘naltirilgan dasturlash (sinflar, obyektlar, inkapsulyatsiya, meros, polimorfizm), interfeyslar, istisnolarni qayta ishlash, kolleksiyalar, fayllar bilan ishlash va ko‘p oqimli dasturlash asoslari o‘rgatiladi. Java korporativ tizimlar, Android ilovalar va server dasturlarida keng qo‘llaniladi.

      For Information Systems and Technologies students. Covers Java syntax and data types, object-oriented programming (classes, objects, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism), interfaces, exception handling, collections, file I/O and the basics of multithreading. Java is widely used in enterprise systems, Android apps and server software.

      Kompyuter tarmoqlarida trafikni filtrlash usullari va dasturiy vositalarini takomillashtirish

      B.M. Babakulov

      AnnotatsiyaAbstract

      Tarmoq xavfsizligini ta’minlashda trafikni tahlil qilish, zararli va ruxsatsiz ma’lumot oqimlarini aniqlash va filtrlashning zamonaviy usullari yoritilgan. Trafikni boshqarish va himoyalash dasturiy vositalarining samaradorligi tahlil qilinib, ularni takomillashtirish bo‘yicha amaliy tavsiyalar berilgan. Axborot xavfsizligi, kompyuter tarmoqlari va kiberxavfsizlik mutaxassislari, tadqiqotchilar va talabalar uchun.

      Modern methods for analysing traffic and for detecting and filtering malicious and unauthorised data flows. Evaluates traffic-control and protection software and gives practical recommendations for improving it. For security and networking specialists, researchers and students.

      EfficientNet neyron tarmog‘idan foydalangan holda po‘latdan yasalgan sirt nuqsonlarini aniqlashni takomillashtirish

      B.M. Babakulov

      AnnotatsiyaAbstract

      Po‘lat sirtidagi nuqsonlarni sun’iy intellekt yordamida aniqlash va tasniflashga bag‘ishlangan. EfficientNet neyron tarmog‘i va SSD (Single Shot MultiBox Detector) algoritmini birlashtirgan EfficientNet-SSD modeli taklif etilgan. NEU-DET ma’lumotlar to‘plamidagi tajribalar modelning yuqori aniqlik, tezkorlik va hisoblash resurslarini tejashini ko‘rsatadi. Sanoatda avtomatlashtirilgan sifat nazorati uchun ilmiy-amaliy ahamiyatga ega.

      Detecting and classifying steel surface defects with AI. Proposes an EfficientNet-SSD model that combines the EfficientNet backbone with the Single Shot MultiBox Detector. Experiments on the NEU-DET dataset show high accuracy, speed and low compute cost, with direct use in automated industrial quality control.

      Universitet haqidaAbout the university

      Chonnam milliy universiteti (전남대학교)

      Chonnam National University (전남대학교)

      • 1952-yil 9-iyunda tashkil etilgan davlat (milliy) universiteti. Bosh kampusi Gwangju shahrida, Yeosu va Hwasun shaharlarida ham kampuslari bor.
      • Koreyaning 10 ta yetakchi (flagship) milliy universitetlaridan biri.
      • 16 ta kollej va 11 ta magistratura maktabi. Taxminan 21 600 talaba, shundan 4 900 ga yaqini magistrant va doktorant.
      • QS, THE va ARWU xalqaro reytinglarida qatnashadi. Shiori: «Haqiqat, ijod, xizmat».
      • A national university founded on 9 June 1952. Main campus in Gwangju, with campuses in Yeosu and Hwasun.
      • One of Korea’s ten flagship national universities.
      • 16 colleges and 11 graduate schools. About 21,600 students, around 4,900 of them postgraduates.
      • Ranked in QS, THE and ARWU. Motto: “Truth, Creativity, Service”.

      Manba:Sources: global.jnu.ac.kr, Wikipedia

      Universitet haqidaAbout the university

      Muhammad al-Xorazmiy nomidagi Toshkent axborot texnologiyalari universiteti

      Tashkent University of Information Technologies named after Muhammad al-Khwarizmi

      • 1955-yilda Toshkent elektrotexnika aloqa instituti sifatida tashkil etilgan. Uzoq yillar Markaziy Osiyoda aloqa muhandislarini tayyorlaydigan yagona oliygoh bo‘lgan.
      • 2002-yilda Toshkent axborot texnologiyalari universitetiga aylantirilgan. Keyinroq Muhammad al-Xorazmiy nomi berilgan.
      • O‘zbekistonda AKT, telekommunikatsiya va dasturiy injiniring bo‘yicha yetakchi oliy ta’lim muassasasi.
      • Nukus, Qarshi, Samarqand, Farg‘ona va Urganch shaharlarida filiallari bor.
      • Founded in 1955 as the Tashkent Electrotechnical Institute of Communications. For decades it was the only school training communication engineers in Central Asia.
      • Reorganised as Tashkent University of Information Technologies in 2002 and later named after Muhammad al-Khwarizmi.
      • Uzbekistan’s leading university for ICT, telecommunications and software engineering.
      • Branches in Nukus, Karshi, Samarkand, Fergana and Urgench.
